def max_average_power(n, k, m, powers):
    # Initial sum of powers
    total_power = sum(powers)
    # We use a max heap to always increase the least powerful superhero
    # Python has a min heap by default, so we invert the values
    max_heap = [-a for a in powers]
    heapify(max_heap)
    
    # Operations to distribute
    operations_left = m
    
    while operations_left > 0:
        # Pop the least powerful superhero
        least_powerful = -heappop(max_heap)
        
        # Calculate the maximum power we can increase this superhero
        max_increase = min(k, operations_left)
        
        # Increase the power and update operations left
        least_powerful += max_increase
        operations_left -= max_increase
        
        # Push the updated power back to the heap
        heappush(max_heap, -least_powerful)
        
        # If there are no more operations left, break the loop
        if operations_left == 0:
            break
    
    # Calculate the maximum possible average after all operations
    # Maximum sum of powers would be the total power of remaining superheroes
    max_total_power = total_power - sum(max(-x for x in max_heap))
    
    # Calculate the maximum possible average
    max_average = max_total_power / n
    
    return max_average
